ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( AND(ISBLANK(Email__c), ISBLANK(Phone__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Role__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Technology__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Work_Location__c)), ISBLANK(Manager__c), ISBLANK(Cost_Per_Hour__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate Role, Technology, Work Location, Manager, Cost Per Hour, and at least one contact method (Email or Phone).
